title: What stangent-point-picker returns (Phase 3, D70)
description: Up to 5 reference pages a ticket is about, chosen from the ranked page list (D87), and up to 3 parts outside the code (D83), each with a sentence quoted word for word from the ticket. Code checks every page exists and every quote is in the ticket.

page.description: The page's number in the list (a page id is also accepted).

quote.description: Words from the ticket, exactly as written there (at least 4 words, or a whole line), that say why.

outside.description: Parts of the ticket whose cause lives outside the code (D83): the server, network, deployment, live data or a third party. Never a screen, an API or the app's own behaviour.

quote.description: Words from the ticket, exactly as written there (at least 4 words, or a whole line), that say so.
